glosses: Augmentable, surpassable, pour une performance, un record, etc.

examples.text: Meines Erachtens ist dieser Rekord kaum steigerbar.
examples.translation: À mon avis, ce record est difficilement surpassable.

examples.text: Ohne entsprechende Investitionen ist die Produktion schwer steigerbar.
examples.translation: Sans investissements correspondants, la production est difficilement augmentable.

glosses: Gradable, comparable, au sujet d’un adjectif qualificatif ou un adverbe.

examples.text: Obwohl es zahlreiche steigerbare Adjektive gibt, ist “steigerbar” selbst nicht steigerbar.
examples.translation: Bien qu’il existe maints adjectifs gradables, « gradable » lui-même n’est pas gradable.

examples.text: Dieser Erfolg ist nicht mehr steigerbar.

glosses: fähig, gesteigert zu werden; so dass man einen Komparativ und Superlativ bilden kann

examples.text: Manche meinen, das Wort „schwarz“ sei nicht steigerbar.

glosses: страд. прич. наст. вр. от увеличивать
Que se puede comparar (examinar para establecer relaciones, semejanzas y diferencias) lógicamente con otro(s), por tener algo en común. Apto para compararse.
Que tiene analogía o similitud con otro(s).

examples.text: Como hemos dicho, el de Sumatra es el segundo terremoto más grande registrado desde el inicio del siglo XX. Los anteriores y de magnitud comparable ocurrieron al norte de Chile.
An elephant is comparable in size to a double-decker bus.
You can't say that robbing a bank is like pickpocketing. The two are just not comparable.
The firebox married to Britannia's boiler is not, however, in the Doncaster tradition, notwithstanding that it is comparable in dimensions to that of the "V2."
As yet, we don't know what the comparable figures will be like for the current financial year which ends in March 2022, but we can have a good stab at approximating them.

Furthermore, this increase in risk is comparable to the risk of death from leukemia after long-term exposure to benzene, another solvent, which has the well-known property of causing this type of cancer.

glosses: Constituting a pair in a particular partial order.

examples.text: Six and forty-two are comparable in the divides order, but six and nine are not.
"Big" is a comparable adjective because it can take the forms "bigger" and "biggest"; "unique" and "amazing", in contrast, are not comparable adjectives.
And the appraiser said he couldn't come up with comparables, because there hadn't been any sales nearby in several months.
